result.brief: RoboRender 提出面向机器人的深度条件视频生成模型，将仿真轨迹转为逼真 RGB 视频以训练可零样本迁移的真实策略，缓解视觉 sim-to-real 差距。
result.reason: Depth-conditioned robot video generation model for sim-to-real policy learning; contributes a video generation model and representation for robot data, enabling world-model-style visual transfer.
